cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4W_Railgun_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

Socket_Mount_Bottom.role: mounting face centre, normal -Y, connects to cell (0,-1,0)

R4W_Railgun_Yaw.role: Yaw: rotate around local Y only

R4W_Railgun_Pitch.role: Pitch: rotate around local X only

R4W_Railgun_Rails.role: rail carriage + 5 accelerator coils: recoils back along local -Z

R4W_Railgun_Emitter.role: separate collimator emitter, child of rails: deploys forward along local +Z when charging

R4W_Railgun_VentFlap_L.role: cooling vent flap: rotates about local Z (outer hinge), opens 60 deg on Cool

R4W_Railgun_VentFlap_R.role: cooling vent flap: rotates about local Z (outer hinge), opens 60 deg on Cool

Rail_CoilGlow_1.role: coil charge glow FX: idle scale 0.001, scale 1 while charged

Rail_CoilGlow_2.role: coil charge glow FX: idle scale 0.001, scale 1 while charged

Rail_CoilGlow_3.role: coil charge glow FX: idle scale 0.001, scale 1 while charged

Rail_CoilGlow_4.role: coil charge glow FX: idle scale 0.001, scale 1 while charged

Rail_CoilGlow_5.role: coil charge glow FX: idle scale 0.001, scale 1 while charged

Rail_ArcFlash.role: arc between the rails on the shot (FX, idle scale 0.001)

visible_exits_note: 1 emitter = 1 Muzzle (penetration up to 6 parts is gameplay, unchanged)
notes: Charge glow is mesh FX (scale) so it survives FBX; emission strength itself is not animated.
